title: Mountain Men
description: A new generation of mountain men takes on the Wild North, as Randy battles wolves threatening his cattle, Kie and Dave target destructive beavers, Broc experiments with a new way to lure bears, and Connor puts his next generation of sled dogs to the test.

title: Mountain Men
description: Broc hauls barrels of honey high into the trees in hopes of drawing bears out of hiding; Kie and Dave make use of every part of their beaver harvest; Connor takes his B-team of sled dogs into the wilderness, where one mistake threatens to derail the run; and Aron and Jen race to clear dangerous deadfall from their property without damaging their home or sparking another wildfire.

title: Mountain Men
description: Broc guides his sister Alicia on her first bear hunt in 20 years; Connor and Jen push their sled teams on a 20-mile overnight expedition across a frozen lake; Kie and Dave tackle a giant poplar tree looming over their homestead; and Rob heads deep into the frozen wilderness to trap beaver and rabbit.

title: Mountain Men
description: A hard-earned trophy is preserved in bone, generations of knowledge are passed down, a hidden hazard threatens a homestead, and a new line of defense is built against fire season.

title: Mountain Men
description: As winter gives way to spring, the Wild North becomes increasingly unpredictable; melting snow, treacherous terrain and a sudden whiteout force the mountain men to race the changing conditions before their windows of opportunity disappear.

title: The UnXplained
description: Whether surviving freezing temperatures, diving unfathomable depths in one breath, or lifting weighty objects, superhuman feats never cease to amaze; pulling them off could be a matter of training, willpower, genetics, or something more mysterious.

title: The UnXplained
description: During The Golden Age of Piracy, thousands of buccaneers terrorized the high seas and became legends; their exploits spawned stories of larger-than-life characters, billion dollar heists, and buried treasure that to this day, has never been found.

title: The UnXplained
description: From the eerie reports of spontaneous human combustion and the hunt for the Highgate Vampire, to the unsettling boogeymen known as the Men in Black appearing after UFO sightings, could these legends be more than just stories?

title: The UnXplained
description: Isolated along the southernmost part of the planet, Antarctica is best known as the frozen continent.

title: The UnXplained
description: People go missing every day, but throughout history, there have been strange and eerie disappearances that continue to capture the world's attention.

title: The UnXplained
description: Every year, people risk their lives to enter places the world has marked off-limits, and in most cases, no one fully understands why; from the psychological forces that compel climbers to press on through the Death Zone of Mount Everest, to a stretch of New Mexico wilderness where at least 15 people have vanished without a trace, to a remote island in the Indian Ocean where trespassers are killed on sight - what is it about the world's most dangerous places that makes them impossible to resist?

title: The UnXplained
description: Across the world, rare medical disorders and extraordinary capabilities reveal how little we truly understand about the human body. From mysterious diseases that freeze people in place to individuals who grow to towering heights, these anomalies challenge the limits of human biology. Are these medical outliers--or evidence that the human body is capable of far stranger things than science has fully explained?

title: The UnXplained
description: Throughout history, powerful nations around the world have enlisted spies to serve as unique tools of warfare; these secret agents are often tasked with infiltrating organizations, gathering sensitive information and even performing the act of assassination; the most successful spies are the ones whose secrets are only revealed years after their mission has ended, or sometimes, never at all.

title: The UnXplained
description: For more than 200 years, treasure hunters have been coming to Oak Island in search of a treasure that has so far eluded them all, and has even cost six men their lives, could it be, as legend suggests, the treasure is protected by a deadly curse.

description: Through records in historical texts, oral tradition and folklore, exploring how a once-thriving community becomes a lost city; what secrets found in the ruins reveal about human history.
